_note: Radu's own runs, read on Wednesday 18 November 2026 at about 10am with plugin 0.7.0 (--unit work): the standup for Tuesday 17 November, for the full week of 9 to 15 November, and for 1 to 18 November. 0.7.0 also reads what was asked in each agent session, so work with no commit (the card game going live, the pension calculator, the review runs behind Switchboard's fixes) is described, not only counted. Real commits and real token counts, shown on the homepage at his request. The day was chosen because it shows the most: commits, merged pull requests, and work with no commit yet. Cost is at Anthropic's list prices of 2026-11-03, one price per model; the Codex model has no price row and is shown as unpriced. Each update follows his style file (a line per project, up to three details under it) and is also written in the five built-in voices, turned up at his request. Four Romanian project names are shown in English so the example reads the same for everyone: My Pension (cat-vine-pensia), pension-meter (pensiometru), Jungle Cards (cartile-pe-fata) and Cotroceni Conference (conferinta-de-la-cotroceni). vibe-check is listed as personal in his settings and is left out. Nothing else is changed. Identifiers in backticks are shown as inline code, as the Slack markup style writes them.
